facts.fact: EAAIF committed a USD 50 million loan on 5 August 2026 to refinance and maintain Liquid Intelligent Technologies' 110,000 km cross-border fibre network across 25 countries, including South Africa, Kenya and Zimbabwe, serving operators, enterprises and hyperscalers.
